items_source_kind_check.name: items_source_kind_check
items_source_kind_check.value: "items"."source" is (case "items"."kind" when 'reddit-post' then 'reddit' when 'reddit-comment' then 'reddit' when 'x-post' then 'x' when 'github-repo' then 'github' when 'article' then 'article' when 'link' then 'other' end)

media_stored_has_file.name: media_stored_has_file
media_stored_has_file.value: ("media"."outcome" = 'stored') = ("media"."file_key" is not null and "media"."content_type" is not null and "media"."size" is not null)

pins_subject_check.name: pins_subject_check
pins_subject_check.value: case "pins"."kind" when 'tag-merge' then ("pins"."into_tag_id" is not null and "pins"."into_topic_id" is null and "pins"."from_item_id" is null and "pins"."into_item_id" is null and "pins"."from_digest" is null and "pins"."into_digest" is null) when 'topic-merge' then ("pins"."into_tag_id" is null and "pins"."into_topic_id" is not null and "pins"."from_item_id" is null and "pins"."into_item_id" is null and "pins"."from_digest" is null and "pins"."into_digest" is null) when 'items-disagree' then ("pins"."into_tag_id" is null and "pins"."into_topic_id" is null and "pins"."from_item_id" is not null and "pins"."into_item_id" is not null and "pins"."from_digest" is not null and "pins"."into_digest" is not null) else 1 end and ("pins"."kind" <> 'items-disagree' or "pins"."from_item_id" <> "pins"."into_item_id")

proposals_accepting_check.name: proposals_accepting_check
proposals_accepting_check.value: "proposals"."state" = 'accepting' or ("proposals"."cursor" is null and "proposals"."moved" is null and "proposals"."unit_revision" is null and "proposals"."failed_runs" is null)

proposals_subject_check.name: proposals_subject_check
proposals_subject_check.value: case "proposals"."kind" when 'tag-merge' then ("proposals"."from_tag_id" is not null and "proposals"."into_tag_id" is not null and "proposals"."from_topic_id" is null and "proposals"."into_topic_id" is null and "proposals"."highlight_id" is null and "proposals"."topic_id" is null and "proposals"."from_item_id" is null and "proposals"."into_item_id" is null and "proposals"."from_digest" is null and "proposals"."into_digest" is null) when 'topic-merge' then ("proposals"."from_tag_id" is null and "proposals"."into_tag_id" is null and "proposals"."from_topic_id" is not null and "proposals"."into_topic_id" is not null and "proposals"."highlight_id" is null and "proposals"."topic_id" is null and "proposals"."from_item_id" is null and "proposals"."into_item_id" is null and "proposals"."from_digest" is null and "proposals"."into_digest" is null) when 'highlight-lost' then ("proposals"."from_tag_id" is null and "proposals"."into_tag_id" is null and "proposals"."from_topic_id" is null and "proposals"."into_topic_id" is null and "proposals"."highlight_id" is not null and "proposals"."topic_id" is null and "proposals"."from_item_id" is null and "proposals"."into_item_id" is null and "proposals"."from_digest" is null and "proposals"."into_digest" is null) when 'overview-gap' then ("proposals"."from_tag_id" is null and "proposals"."into_tag_id" is null and "proposals"."from_topic_id" is null and "proposals"."into_topic_id" is null and "proposals"."highlight_id" is null and "proposals"."topic_id" is not null and "proposals"."from_item_id" is null and "proposals"."into_item_id" is null and "proposals"."from_digest" is null and "proposals"."into_digest" is null) when 'items-disagree' then ("proposals"."from_tag_id" is null and "proposals"."into_tag_id" is null and "proposals"."from_topic_id" is null and "proposals"."into_topic_id" is null and "proposals"."highlight_id" is null and "proposals"."topic_id" is null and "proposals"."from_item_id" is not null and "proposals"."into_item_id" is not null and "proposals"."from_digest" is not null and "proposals"."into_digest" is not null) else 1 end and ("proposals"."kind" <> 'items-disagree' or "proposals"."from_item_id" <> "proposals"."into_item_id")

settings_cli_choice.name: settings_cli_choice
settings_cli_choice.value: "settings"."cli_choice" = 'custom' or ("settings"."cli_choice" in ('recommended', 'cli-defaults') and "settings"."provider" in ('claude-code', 'codex') and "settings"."model" = '' and "settings"."effort" is null)

settings_custom_cli_overrides.name: settings_custom_cli_overrides
settings_custom_cli_overrides.value: "settings"."cli_choice" <> 'custom' or "settings"."provider" not in ('claude-code', 'codex') or trim("settings"."model") <> '' or nullif(trim("settings"."effort"), '') is not null

settings_connection_columns.name: settings_connection_columns
settings_connection_columns.value: ("settings"."provider" in ('workers-ai', 'claude-code', 'codex') and "settings"."base_url" is null and "settings"."sealed_key" is null) or ("settings"."provider" not in ('workers-ai', 'claude-code', 'codex') and "settings"."base_url" is not null and "settings"."sealed_key" is not null)

vault_settings_target.name: vault_settings_target
vault_settings_target.value:
("vault_settings"."mode" = 'github' and "vault_settings"."repository" is not null and "vault_settings"."branch" is not null and "vault_settings"."sealed_token" is not null and "vault_settings"."folder" is null)
        or ("vault_settings"."mode" = 'folder' and "vault_settings"."folder" is not null and substr("vault_settings"."folder", 1, 1) = '/' and "vault_settings"."repository" is null and "vault_settings"."branch" is null and "vault_settings"."sealed_token" is null)
